items.title: Sovereignty by Design
items.summary: Data ownership is not a feature you add at the end. It is the first architectural decision, and every later choice inherits it.

items.title: Leadership as Systems Work
items.summary: A leader who optimises individual effort mistakes motion for progress. The leverage is in the connections, not the nodes.

items.title: The Tutor Imperative
items.summary: Teaching is the only profession that manufactures its own successors. Royal tutoring is the discipline of building judgement, not recall.
